column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3627): one subtest per dialect that has a library schema (PostgreSQL and SQL Server; MySQL has none, D41), each through testutil.TestDB. This job configures PostgreSQL only, so the sqlserver subtest skips ONCE while postgres RUNS. Measured by name, not by delta: go test ./engine/ -run '^TestATenantListsOnlyItsOwnLibraryInstalls$' -count=1 -json with only the named DSN set. Postgres only: pass /postgres_as_a_role_the_policy_applies_to, skip /sqlserver.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: the same test and the same one skipped arm; the cluster job runs ./engine/... too and configures PostgreSQL only. See the test-go/engine line.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres arm skips while sqlserver RUNS. Measured by name, not by delta: go test ./engine/ -run '^TestATenantListsOnlyItsOwnLibraryInstalls$' -count=1 -json with only the named DSN set. SQL Server only: skip /postgres_as_a_role_the_policy_applies_to, pass /sqlserver.
